findings.finding: Set B=(0,0),C=(F_{n+2},0),I=(F_n,r). Tangents give AB=c,AC=c+F_{n-1}. Solve cyclic condition B,N,K,K' ⇒ unique c. Ratio CT·NB/(BT·NE)=F_{n+2}/F_{n-1}. Hence a_{2n}=F_{2n+2}/F_{2n-1}→φ³=2+√5. So p=2,q=5. Compute 2^{5²}=2^{25}=33 554 432; mod 99991 = 57447.

Found BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ a=BC=Fₙ₊₂, s> a. Using coordinates (B(0,0),C(a,0),D(Fₙ,0)), solve incircle geometry. Condition “KNK′B cyclic’’ forces s rational giving K,N,K′,B concyclic. Computed ratio CT·NB/(BT·NE)=Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁. Hence aₙ=Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁→φ³=2+√5. α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5 ⇒ ⌊2^{5²}⌋=2²⁵. Mod 99991 gives 57447.
